# Downtime Protocols & Common Rules

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
from sr6core.log_engine import get_log_totals
from sr6core.character_manager import CharacterManager

cm = CharacterManager()
_char = cm.get_character_data("yuriko") or {}
attrs = _char.get("attributes", {})
log_totals = get_log_totals("chapters/character_log.qmd")

RESONANCE = attrs.get("resonance", 8)
WILLPOWER = attrs.get("willpower", 6)
CHARISMA = attrs.get("charisma", 4)
INTUITION = attrs.get("intuition", 2)
LOGIC = attrs.get("logic", 4)

ACTIVE_A = 7
ACTIVE_S = 9
ACTIVE_D = 7
ACTIVE_F = 9

RESONANCE_FOCUS = 4
SUBMERSION_GRADE = log_totals.get("Submersion_Grade", 7)
PA_RATING = 6
DIRECTIONAL_SHIELDS = 1

active_asdf = f"{ACTIVE_A}{ACTIVE_S}{ACTIVE_D}{ACTIVE_F}"
full_def_pool = RESONANCE + ACTIVE_F + PA_RATING + ACTIVE_D + RESONANCE_FOCUS + DIRECTIONAL_SHIELDS # 8 + 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 + 1 = 35 -> 33
full_def_hits = 8 # 33d6 = 8 Hits
edge_storage = 5 + SUBMERSION_GRADE
```

This landing hub consolidates Reiko's downtime protocols, calculation shortcuts, and mechanics cheat sheets across four dedicated domain references.

## Domain Protocol Directories

Select a domain reference for full formulas, dice pool breakdowns, step-by-step downtime guides, and action tables:

1. **[Matrix & Network Protocols](rules_matrix.qmd)**: Base & Active ASDF attributes, standardized Matrix action pools, network benefits, learned programs, Full Matrix Defense step-by-step breakdown, remote node & Sanctuary Host architecture, and decking cheat sheet.
2. **[Sprites & Resonance Protocols](rules_sprites.qmd)**: Complex Forms roster, step-by-step compiling & registering downtime math, Technoshaman fading mitigation, and Resonance Focus fading calculations.
3. **[Drones & Rigging Protocols](rules_drones.qmd)**: Detailed drone stat blocks (Shiawase Butler, Man-at-Arms, MCT Gnat), retractable skates rules, standardized drone action pools, Jumped-In vs Remote AI attribute mapping rules, and Sensor Lock mechanics.
4. **[Weapons & Tactical Gear Protocols](rules_combat.qmd)**: Standardized weapon attack tables (Red Fox array, Crimson Wasp array, Tesla Coil, Ares Predator VI, Monofilament Whip, Amalgam Cestas), firing mode rules, Attack Rating modification breakdown, laser battery rules, and Krime Splash ammunition table.
